exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench, grip bar slightly wider than shoulders, lower to chest, press up

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lie on bench with dumbbells, press up and together

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degrees, press dumbbells up

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width, lower chest to ground, push up

exercises.name: Cable Flyes
exercises.instructions: Stand between cables, bring handles together in front

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on upper back, squat down until thighs parallel, stand up

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on front shoulders, squat down keeping torso upright

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge at hips, lower bar to mid-shin, return to standing

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width on platform, lower knees to 90 degrees, press up

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.instructions: Rear foot elevated on bench, lower front knee to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Lie face down, curl heels toward glutes

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.instructions: Stand on edge, raise heels as high as possible

exercises.name: Pull-ups
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar, pull chin over bar, lower with control

exercises.name: Barbell Row
exercises.instructions: Bend over at hips, pull bar to lower chest

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull bar down to upper chest, squeeze shoulder blades

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.instructions: Pull handle to torso, squeeze shoulder blades together

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: One knee on bench, pull dumbbell to hip

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Lift bar from ground to standing position, hinge at hips

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.instructions: Press bar from shoulders to overhead, lock out arms

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Press dumbbells from shoulders to overhead

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.instructions: Raise dumbbells out to sides until shoulder height

exercises.name: Front Raises
exercises.instructions: Raise dumbbells in front to shoulder height

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.instructions: Pull rope to face, externally rotate shoulders

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl bar from thighs to shoulders, keep elbows stationary

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl dumbbells alternating or together

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.instructions: Curl with palms facing each other

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.instructions: Lower body by bending elbows, press back up

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.instructions: Push cable down until arms fully extended

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.instructions: Extend weight overhead, lower behind head

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Hold forearm plank position, keep body straight

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.instructions: Lie on back, lift shoulders off ground

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raises
exercises.instructions: Hang from bar, raise legs to 90 degrees

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.instructions: Sit with feet elevated, rotate torso side to side

exercises.name: Cable Woodchoppers
exercises.instructions: Pull cable diagonally across body in chopping motion
